meta.name: slideshow
meta.description: Author a HyperFrames slideshow — a presentation, pitch deck, or interactive deck with discrete slides, fragment reveals, branching, hotspot navigation, and built-in presenter mode with speaker notes; also converts an existing page into a deck. Output is a navigable deck, not a rendered MP4. If the user didn't explicitly ask for a slideshow, confirm before authoring. Unclear → /hyperframes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把内容变成可交互的演示文稿
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要制作带分支导航和演讲者备注的交互式幻灯片
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to create interactive slides with branching and speaker notes

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会按 HyperFrames 规范制作幻灯片演示:每页独立画面,支持逐步揭示、分支跳转、热点点击和演讲者备注;也能把现有网页转成这种 deck。产出是可运行的 deck,不是视频。没明说要幻灯片时,会先确认。
howto.when: 当你明确要求做幻灯片或交互式 deck 等,或想把现有页面转成幻灯片时触发。若只是提到“presentation”等相邻说法,它会先说明并问你确认,同意后才动手。

say.text: 把这页内容做成一份幻灯片演示
say.note: 会生成可导航的 deck,每页一张幻灯片。

say.text: 把当前这个网页转成可交互的演示 deck
say.note: 会先确认,再按原页面还原设计。

say.text: 做一份带演讲者备注和跳转热点的路演
say.note: 会包含分支与热点导航。

howto.what_en: With this skill, Claude builds a navigable HyperFrames deck: slides, fragments, branches, hotspots, presenter notes. It can also convert a page into a deck. Output is a runnable deck, not a video. Confirms first unless explicitly requested.
howto.when_en: Triggers on explicit requests for a slideshow, interactive deck, or page conversion. For adjacent terms like 'presentation', it explains and asks for confirmation.

say_en.text: Turn this content into a slideshow presentation.
say_en.note: Produces a navigable deck, one slide per page.

say_en.text: Convert this webpage into an interactive deck.
say_en.note: Confirms first, then preserves the original design.

say_en.text: Build a pitch deck with speaker notes and hotspot links.
